author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A coral snail about 2 cm long that lives on and near corals and sea fans, where it feeds on the coral tissue. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Isla Uvita, 2000).
note.es: Un caracol coralífago de unos 2 cm que vive sobre y cerca de corales y abanicos de mar, donde se alimenta del tejido del coral. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Isla Uvita, 2000).

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Isla Uvita, 2000)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
